//: Serverless functions compile separately from the Vite app and MUST emit JS.
Deliberately standalone rather than extending ../tsconfig.json: that config
is built for the browser bundle and sets noEmit:true (forced by its
allowImportingTsExtensions), so Vercel's Node builder picked it up and failed
the deploy with 'api/waitlist.ts: Emit skipped'. The app's tsconfig only
includes src/**/*, so this directory is invisible to `pnpm run typecheck`
and needs its own settings regardless.
